completenessRule: A control is decided only where a recovered assessment states its applicability. The remaining controls are carried as pending-assessment and are not asserted to be either applicable or excluded. This statement is therefore complete in its control set and explicitly incomplete in its decisions.

controls.decisionBasis: Recovered from the V1 ISO 27001 alignment assessment, which decided this control explicitly.
controls.rationale: Repository governance standards and authority model are defined as source artefacts, but formal approval, publication, and periodic communication of an information security policy set are operating-management activities not present in the repository.
controls.title: Policies for information security

controls.decisionBasis: Recovered from the V1 ISO 27001 alignment assessment, which decided this control explicitly.
controls.title: Information security roles and responsibilities

controls.decisionBasis: Decided by the operator against the declared ISMS scope facts recorded on the statement of applicability. Not recovered from a historical assessment.
controls.rationale: Segregation of duties is applicable and cannot be achieved by separation of people, because a sole operator performs every role. It is addressed by compensating controls rather than excluded: the repository's authority model, the requirement that a semantic transaction validate the whole resulting corpus before applying, and durable provenance on every authority change. Recording it as not applicable would understate a real and accepted risk.

controls.decisionBasis: Decided by the operator against the declared ISMS scope facts recorded on the statement of applicability. Not recovered from a historical assessment.
controls.rationale: Management responsibilities apply. The sole operator is also the management function, so the obligation is to define and follow the ISMS rather than to direct others.

controls.decisionBasis: Decided by the operator against the declared ISMS scope facts recorded on the statement of applicability. Not recovered from a historical assessment.

controls.decisionBasis: Decided by the operator against the declared ISMS scope facts recorded on the statement of applicability. Not recovered from a historical assessment.
